title: Stack overflow in sensor_task
serial_logs:
***ERROR*** A stack overflow in task sensor_task has been detected.
Backtrace: 0x40081e7a:0x3ffb5b60 0x40089c45:0x3ffb5b80 0x4008a9b2:0x3ffb5ba0
Rebooting...

reference_context.title: ESP-IDF Programming Guide (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: On ESP-IDF, usStackDepth is specified in bytes (not words). Local arrays are allocated on the task stack.

expected.root_cause: sensor_task has a 1024-byte stack but allocates a 2048-byte local buffer, overflowing the stack.
expected.fix: Increase the stack (e.g. 4096) and/or make the buffer static or heap-allocated.
